notes: retries=2 on the Cosmos tasks: the job carries the tag `dagster/max_retries=2`, so Dagster re-launches a failed run up to 2 time(s) from the failed step (run retries must be enabled on the deployment: `run_retries.enabled` in dagster.yaml, off by default in open source). The dbt component has no retry-policy field (its `op` takes name, tags, description, pool, backfill_policy), so this is run-level. Cosmos retried one task per model; here one `dbt build` is the unit, and `dbt retry` re-runs only the models that failed. A behaviour change, and an improvement (`dbt retry` is a dbt command the converter does not wire in)
Cosmos emitted an Airflow Dataset per model; the dbt assets have their own keys, so a DAG scheduled on those datasets needs an automation condition on the dbt asset keys
profiles.yml (profiles.yml) lives inside the dbt project and is used as it is; it was not read, so check it for inline credentials (use env_var() for every secret)

caveats.reason: test_behavior=AFTER_ALL runs every model, then one test task. The component runs `dbt build`, which runs each model's tests right after it, so a failing test now stops the models downstream of it, which Airflow did not do under AFTER_ALL
dbt assets with the same keys are already produced by another DAG or Cosmos group; Dagster allows one producer per asset, so these assets are keyed under `by_shop_mixed_transform/`

converter_changes: asset keys are prefixed `by_shop_mixed_transform/` (the component's key_prefix; no model file changes)
